title: Abort ongoing navigate events in stop loading and document.open()
body: When a navigable's `ongoing navigation` is not a `navigation ID` (such as during a same-document navigation's `navigate` event dispatch, during an intercepted fragment/`pushState`/`reload`/`traverse` navigation, or before an unintercepted same-document navigation's completion microtask runs), calling `window.stop()` or `document.open()` previously did not `inform the navigation API about aborting navigation`. Update `stop loading` (when `unload counter` is 0) and the `document open steps` (when `node navigable` is non-null) to `inform the navigation API about aborting navigation` in the fallback branch when `ongoing navigation` is not a `navigation ID`. Also guard running the `navigate event intercept commit handler steps` on `navigateEvent` being non-null (as reached when `document.open()` runs the `URL and history update steps` after aborting or with no ongoing navigation), and remove the obsolete `ongoing navigation` ID assignment in `navigate to a fragment`. Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/65594. Fixes #12247. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Gecko (filed #12247; already implements aborting ongoing `navigate` events in `document.open()`) * Chromium (already implements aborting ongoing `navigate` events in `window.stop()`) * WebKit (already implements aborting ongoing `navigate` events in `window.stop()`) - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/65594 - [ ] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: … (fails `signal-abort-document-open.html` and `signal-abort-window-stop-reentrant-navigateerror.html`) * Gecko: … (not yet run; `nsDocShell::StopInternal` only aborts when ongoing navigation is a navigation ID, so `window.stop()` subtests are expected to fail) * WebKit: … (fails `signal-abort-document-open.html`) - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
